==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*peḱ-|id=livestock}} From {{inh|en|enm|fee}}, {{m|enm|fe}}, {{m|enm|feh}}, {{m|enm|feoh}}, from {{inh|en|ang|feoh||cattle, property, wealth, money, payment, tribute, fee}} with contamination from {{der|en|fro|fieu}}, {{m|fro|fief}} (from {{der|en|la-med|fevum}}, a variant of {{m|la|feudum}} (see {{doublet|en|feud|id1=estate|notext=1}}), from {{der|en|frk|*fehu|t=cattle, livestock}}; whence {{doublet|en|fief|notext=1}}), both from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*fehu|t=cattle, sheep, livestock, owndom}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro|*péḱu|t=livestock}}. {{col-top|2|cog}} Cognate with {{cog|stq|Fäi|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|fy|fee|t=livestock}}, {{cog|cim|biighe}}, {{m|cim|viighe|t=animal, beast}}, {{cog|nl|vee|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|de|Viech|t=animal, beast}}, {{m|de|Vieh|t=livestock}}, {{cog|nds-de|Veeh|t=cattle, livestock, property}}, {{cog|lb|Véi|t=cattle}}, {{cog|wym|fi}}, {{m|wym|fī}}, {{m|wym|fii}}, {{m|wym|fiih|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|yi|פֿי}}, {{m|yi|פֿיך|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|da,fo|fæ|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|is|fé|t=assets, livestock, money}}, {{cog|nb,nn|fe|t=cattle, livestock}}, {{cog|sv|fä|t=beast, cattle, dolt}}, {{cog|got|𐍆𐌰𐌹𐌷𐍉}}, {{m|got|𐍆𐌰𐌹𐌷𐌿|t=possessions, property; riches, wealth; money}}; also {{cog|la|pecū|t=cattle}}, {{cog|prg|pecku|t=cattle}}, {{cog|hy|ասր|t=fleece, wool}}, {{cog|ae|𐬞𐬀𐬯𐬎|t=livestock}}, {{cog|xbc|ποσο|t=sheep}}, {{cog|ckb|پەز|t=sheep}}, {{cog|kmr|pez|t=sheep}}, {{cog|os|фыс|t=sheep}}, {{cog|tly|pəs}}, {{m|tly|пәс|t=sheep}}, {{cog|sa|पशु|t=cattle}}. {{col-bottom}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|fē}} {{IPA|en|/fiː/}} * {{audio|en|en-us-fee.ogg|a=US}} * {{rhymes|en|iː|s=1}} * {{homophones|en|fi}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun}} # An amount charged in return for [[permission]] to do something: #: {{coi|en|television license '''fee'''}} ## An amount charged [[ancillary]] to the (occasionally null) base cost of a [[product]] or [[service]]; an additional charge, nominally for some additional privilege, ability or permission. ##: {{coi|en|booking '''fee''', late '''fee'''}} ##: {{ux|en|no hidden '''fees''';   the sticker price is $1 but all the extra '''fees''' push the price into triple digits;   it costs just 4.99 and there are no '''fees'''}} ## An amount charged for something: the base cost of purchasing some thing, service, etc. ##: {{syn|en|tax}} ##: {{coi|en|admission '''fee''', membership '''fee''', drivers' license '''fee'''}} ##: {{ux|en|the '''fee''' for entry to the zoo is increasing from 50 to 60 dollars}} # A fixed [[rate]] or [[price]] charged for (chiefly [[white-collar]]) professional services. #: {{coi|en|lawyers' '''fees''', tuition '''fee''', bank '''fees''', legal '''fees''', consulting '''fee'''}} # {{lb|en|law}} An [[inheritable]] [[estate in land]], whether [[absolute]] and [[without]] [[limitation]] to [[potential]] [[heir]]s ([[fee simple]]) or with [[limitation]]s to [[particular]] [[kind]]s of [[heir]]s ([[fee tail]]). # {{lb|en|law|historical}} A [[right]] to the [[use]] of a [[superior]]'s [[land]] as a [[stipend]] for [[certain]] [[service]]s to be [[performed]], [[typically]] [[military service]]. # {{lb|en|law|historical}} {{synonym of|en|fief}}: the [[land]] [[so]] [[held]]. # {{lb|en|law|historical}} An [[inheritable]] [[estate in land]] [[held]] of a [[feudal]] [[lord]] [[on condition]] of [[performance]] of [[certain]] [[service]]s, [[typically]] [[military service]]. # {{lb|en|figurative|obsolete}} {{synonym of|en|possession}}. #* {{quote-journal|en|year=1844|journal=[[s:The Heritage|The Heritage]]|author={{w|James Russell Lowell}} |passage=What doth the poor man's son inherit?
Stout muscles and a sinewy heart,
A hardy frame, a hardier spirit;
King of two hands, he does his part
In every useful toil and art;
A heritage, it seems to me,
A king might wish to hold in '''fee'''.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=a.1881|title='To Milton', in Poems|author={{w|Oscar Wilde}}|url=https://poets.org/poem/milton-0|passage=This England, this sea-lion of the sea,
By ignorant demagogues is held in '''fee''',
Who love her not: Dear God! is this the land
Which bare a triple empire in her hand
When Cromwell spake the word Democracy!}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1915|author=[[w:W. Somerset Maugham|W.S. Maugham]]|title=w:Of Human Bondage|section=[[s:Of Human Bondage/Chapter CXXI|chapter 121]] |passage=Cronshaw had told him that the facts of life mattered nothing to him who by the power of fancy held in '''fee''' the twin realms of space and time.}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} Money paid or bestowed; payment; [[emolument]]. # {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[prize]] or [[reward]].
